entries.name: Sign in with Google
entries.purpose: One-tap sign-in with a Google account on the phone and the web.
entries.sandbox: Any Google account; the OAuth consent screen stays in testing until launch. Only openid, email and profile scopes, so no Google verification is needed.

entries.name: Sign in with Apple
entries.purpose: One-tap sign-in with an Apple ID on the phone and the web, with Hide My Email.
entries.sandbox: Any Apple ID on a development build. Needs the Apple Developer account (apple-developer) first.

entries.name: Twilio Verify (phone sign-in codes)
entries.purpose: Sends and checks the six-digit codes for phone sign-in and two-step checks, with fraud protection.
entries.sandbox: Twilio test credentials; Verify sends to verified numbers on a trial account.

entries.name: Cloudflare for SaaS (tenant custom domains)
entries.purpose: Tenants' own domains (learn.example.com) with automatic SSL, verified from Branding and domain or Brokerage settings.
entries.sandbox: A staging zone with Cloudflare for SaaS enabled; 100 custom hostnames free.

entries.name: Google Calendar
entries.purpose: Two-way calendar for every role. Appointments, showings, deadlines and to-do due dates made in REOS go to the calendar the person picks; changes in Google come back live.
entries.sandbox: Test users on an unverified Google Cloud project (up to 100) until verification is approved.

entries.name: Outlook Calendar
entries.purpose: Two-way calendar for Microsoft 365 and Outlook.com. Appointments, showings, deadlines and to-do due dates made in REOS go to the calendar the person picks; changes in Outlook come back live.
entries.sandbox: Microsoft 365 Developer Program tenant, or a personal Outlook.com account.

entries.name: Apple Calendar (iCloud)
entries.purpose: Read events from iCloud calendars.
entries.sandbox: Any Apple ID with an app-specific password.

entries.name: Zoom
entries.purpose: Meeting links for showings, sessions and client calls.
entries.sandbox: Zoom Marketplace development app; any Zoom account until published.

entries.name: Microsoft Teams meetings
entries.purpose: Teams meeting links on REOS events.

entries.name: Google Meet
entries.purpose: Google Meet links on REOS events.
entries.sandbox: Uses the Google Calendar and Gmail connection.

entries.name: ShowingTime
entries.purpose: Showing requests and confirmations on the REOS calendar.

entries.name: BrokerBay
entries.purpose: Showing and appointment bookings on the REOS calendar.

entries.name: Amazon Transcribe and Polly (speech)
entries.purpose: Voice to-dos and notes (speech to text) and audio-only lessons (text to speech).

entries.name: Stripe (Checkout, Billing, Tax)
entries.purpose: Web checkout, subscriptions, invoices and Texas sales tax.

entries.name: Stripe Connect (payouts)
entries.purpose: Payouts to schools, instructors and mentors; tenants can connect their own Stripe account.
entries.sandbox: Stripe test mode with test connected accounts.

entries.name: PayPal
entries.purpose: Alternative web checkout, switchable per state and product.

entries.name: Authorize.net
entries.purpose: Gateway for associations and brokerages that already bank through Authorize.net.

entries.name: Expo push notifications (APNs, FCM)
entries.purpose: Push notifications to the iOS and Android apps.

entries.name: Amazon SES (email)
entries.purpose: Transactional email, digests and the morning brief.

entries.name: Twilio SMS
entries.purpose: SMS alerts and codes, with quiet hours.
entries.sandbox: Twilio test credentials and a trial number.

entries.name: LiveKit Cloud
entries.purpose: Mentor sessions and live classes (rooms, whiteboard, consented recording).

entries.name: Mux Video
entries.purpose: Lesson video streaming and offline download.

entries.name: Synthesia (AI avatar lessons)
entries.purpose: Render AI avatar lesson videos from approved scripts, in English and Spanish.
entries.sandbox: Trial workspace; the API needs a plan with API access (test videos are watermarked and free).

entries.name: HeyGen (AI avatar lessons)
entries.purpose: Render AI avatar lesson videos from approved scripts, in English and Spanish.
entries.sandbox: Buy a small amount of API credits (pay as you go; no plan needed).

entries.name: Claude on Amazon Bedrock
entries.purpose: AI answers with sources, course drafting, contract review, role-play; first used to turn spoken notes into to-dos (B4.3).

entries.name: Amazon Titan Text Embeddings V2 on Bedrock
entries.purpose: Search course content by meaning (knowledge base passages, 1,024 dimensions in pgvector).

entries.name: Amazon Textract
entries.purpose: Read uploaded CE certificates and licences.

entries.name: Follow Up Boss
entries.purpose: Two-way contacts, notes and tasks; newest change wins.
entries.sandbox: Free trial account; register a system key.

entries.name: kvCORE / BoldTrail
entries.purpose: Two-way contacts, notes and tasks.
entries.sandbox: A test account's API token (Lead Engine › Lead Dropbox) and Developer Portal access.

entries.name: Lofty
entries.purpose: Two-way leads, notes and tasks; stage and tags written back.
entries.sandbox: A Lofty test account's API key (Settings › Integrations › API).

entries.name: Salesforce
entries.purpose: Contacts, leads, tasks and activities for brokerages on Salesforce.

entries.name: Lone Wolf Transactions
entries.purpose: Deals, documents and deadlines; deadline alerts; coordinator sharing.

entries.name: dotloop
entries.purpose: Loops, documents and deadlines.

entries.name: SkySlope
entries.purpose: Files, documents and deadlines.

entries.name: Open to Close
entries.purpose: Transaction coordination: deals, tasks and deadlines.

entries.name: Paperless Pipeline
entries.purpose: Brokerage transactions, documents and checklists.

entries.name: ListedKit
entries.purpose: AI transaction coordinator: deals and deadlines.

entries.name: BoldTrail BackOffice
entries.purpose: Brokerage back office: deals, commissions and agent billing.

entries.name: DocuSign
entries.purpose: Send, track and store signatures from REOS.

entries.name: Zillow leads
entries.purpose: New Zillow Premier Agent leads, sent to the default CRM.
entries.sandbox: Zillow partner test account on approval.

entries.name: Realtor.com leads
entries.purpose: New Realtor.com leads, sent to the default CRM.

entries.name: Homes.com leads
entries.purpose: New Homes.com leads, sent to the default CRM.

entries.name: Phone contacts
entries.purpose: Names, numbers and emails from the phone, so a new agent starts with a contact list.

entries.name: HAR MLS (Houston)
entries.purpose: Agents' listings for posts, CMAs, public pages and open houses.

entries.name: NTREIS (North Texas)
entries.purpose: Agents' listings for posts, CMAs, public pages and open houses.

entries.name: Unlock MLS / ACTRIS (Austin)
entries.purpose: Agents' listings for posts, CMAs, public pages and open houses.

entries.name: SABOR MLS (San Antonio)
entries.purpose: Agents' listings for posts, CMAs, public pages and open houses.

entries.name: TREC licence lookup
entries.purpose: Verify agent, broker and inspector licences in seconds.

entries.name: TREC CE completion reporting
entries.purpose: Report CE completions to TREC (by the school, or REOS on its behalf).
entries.sandbox: None; test with TREC's guidance before go-live.

entries.name: NMLS Consumer Access
entries.purpose: Verify mortgage loan officer licences for service providers.

entries.name: Texas Department of Insurance licence lookup
entries.purpose: Verify insurance agent licences for service providers.

entries.name: Instagram and Facebook
entries.purpose: Post, schedule and read insights.

entries.name: LinkedIn
entries.purpose: Post to profiles and company pages; insights.

entries.name: Google Business Profile
entries.purpose: Posts and insights on the agent's Google listing.
entries.sandbox: Same Google Cloud project as Google Workspace.

entries.name: YouTube
entries.purpose: Short video posting and insights.
entries.sandbox: Same Google Cloud project; unverified apps upload as private.

entries.name: TikTok
entries.purpose: Short video posting and insights.
entries.sandbox: Sandbox app; unaudited apps can only post privately.

entries.name: Mapbox
entries.purpose: Provider service areas on a map.

entries.name: QuickBooks Online
entries.purpose: Export split sheets and payouts for brokerages.

entries.name: Texas REALTORS® single sign-on and member data (NRDS)
entries.purpose: Members sign in with their association login; member records, CE and programs stay in sync.
entries.sandbox: Ask for a test environment of the membership system.

entries.name: Sentry
entries.purpose: Error tracking for web, API and mobile.

entries.name: PostHog
entries.purpose: Product analytics, funnels and session insights.

entries.name: OpenTelemetry and Grafana
entries.purpose: Tracing, metrics and dashboards.
